response.text:
I can’t run continuously in the background or ping you later from here. However, I can help you set up a reliable alternative. Which of these do you want?

- I can check the status once right now if you give the resource (URL, API, service) and explain what “status change” means.
- I can give a short script you can run on your machine or server to poll every few minutes and notify you (email, Slack, Telegram, etc.). I’ll include a cron line to run it automatically.
- I can walk you through using a monitoring service (UptimeRobot, Pingdom, Zapier/IFTTT) that will send alerts to your chosen channel.
- If you want me to create a calendar reminder or draft an email/notification, I can prepare that (but I won’t send it unless you confirm).

If you want the script option, tell me:
1) what resource to monitor (URL or API endpoint),  
2) how you want to be notified (email, Slack webhook, Telegram, SMS), and  
3) polling interval (e.g., every 5 minutes).

Example (brief) — Python + Slack webhook idea I can customize for you:
- Run every 5 minutes via cron: */5 * * * * /usr/bin/python3 /path/to/check.py
- Script outline (you’ll fill credentials):
  - Poll URL, parse status
  - Compare to previous status saved to file
  - If changed, POST message to Slack webhook (or send email)

Tell me which option and the required details and I’ll provide the exact script/instructions.
